label: RESILIX / SWISS EMERGENCY INTELLIGENCE
title:
Clarity when
it matters.
body: A calm, connected workspace for understanding hazards and preparing the next step.
footnote: Hackathon prototype. Emergency services retain responsibility for emergency response.

label: 01 / THE MOMENT
title:
The situation changes.
The context is scattered.
body: People must piece together weather warnings, local observations, and unfamiliar guidance while under pressure.
footnote: Problem hypothesis based on the supplied emergency-assistant use case; user research is still needed.

label: 02 / ONE WORKSPACE
title:
See. Understand.
Prepare.
body: Resilix brings public reports, personal observations, and a conversational assistant into one focused workflow.
footnote: An empty public feed is not an all-clear. Missing and unavailable data remain explicit.

label: 03 / THE CONVERSATION
title:
Speak naturally.
Get a clearer picture.
body: Text, live voice, live dictation, structured cards, and generated illustrations share the same assistant surface.
footnote: Provider availability is checked at runtime. Generated illustrations are not certified maps or evacuation routes.

label: 04 / TRUST BOUNDARIES
title:
Private by design.
Human by decision.
body: Public information stays distinct from private reports. The assistant helps reason; it does not dispatch responders.
footnote: Voice and text are sent to the selected AI provider when used. Formal compliance certification is outside this prototype.

label: 05 / THE SYSTEM
title:
One controlled path
from context to answer.
body: An independent web layer connects through a Rust backend to an isolated AI core. Provider credentials stay in the core.
footnote: Target architecture. Deployment and provider checks must be verified for each environment.

label: 06 / THE FIRST PILOT
title:
Start with readiness.
Earn operational trust.
body: Test one bounded preparation workflow with a local safety team, then measure whether people understand the situation better.
footnote: Commercial hypothesis. No customers, revenue, pricing validation, or emergency-service partnership is claimed.

label: 07 / WHAT COMES NEXT
title:
Validate before
we automate.
body: The next step is better evidence, safer evaluation, and a human-reviewed operational pilot.
footnote: Autonomous dispatch, certified evacuation routing, and camera-based hazard prediction require further validation.

label: RESILIX / LET’S BUILD RESILIENCE
title:
A clearer next step.
Together.
body: Explore the demo. Challenge the assumptions. Help shape a safer, more useful assistant.
footnote: In an immediate emergency, call 112. Resilix does not contact emergency services.
